context:
Ordinary (non-batch) item, after feature batch `skillspector-remediation`. It closes when its own pin-bump PR has merged and the live apply is verified. The owner's 'merge once checks pass' decision for PR #118 is applied to this pin-bump PR too, because the import decision cannot take effect without it; say so in the report. Guardrails: never `git add -A`; stage explicit paths. Commit as the human author in ~/.gitconfig, no agent co-author trailer. No push to main and no history rewrite. Do not reword skill prose to dodge a keyword rule. Do not touch files outside this item's scope; report adjacent issues instead. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` before each commit; a failure blocks the commit. Decision gates: (1) If preview shows any removal, or a change outside the two new skills and the files the rev bump implies, stop and report before apply. (2) If skill-sync refuses the unmanaged directories, move them to the backup directory (never delete), then apply. (3) If the installed unmanaged copies differ from the catalog copies, stop and report. (4) If the semantic pass changed skills/shared-agent-execution, ask the owner whether to bump that group's rev too. Guardrails: never touch ~/.claude/skills/synced or ~/.codex/skills/.system; never point the config at an authoring worktree; `rev` is a full SHA present in ~/Developer/skill-sync-skills (fetch there first without disturbing local changes).


[owner decisions 2026-11-13, second round] Agent squash-merges the deployment PR once checks pass, then applies, verifies and checks the live loaders; stops if preview shows anything unexpected. If the batch changed skills/shared-agent-execution, bump that group's rev to the PR #118 merge commit in the same PR. Back up hand-installed copies and ~/.agents/.skill-lock.json and remove the two lock entries first.
description: The deployment template pins an existing catalog commit, so it cannot select retro and writing-for-agents in the same PR that adds them. After PR #118 merges, a second small PR adds both `skill =` lines to the first catalog group in deployment/global/skill-sync.conf and bumps that group's `rev` to the PR #118 merge commit (this repository's established 'pin the global catalog' pattern); the separate shared-agent-execution group keeps its own rev. Then ~/.skill-sync-deployment/skill-sync.conf takes the same change and preview/apply/verify/check run, so all three loader folders get the catalog copies. ~/.claude/skills holds unmanaged copies of both skills from `npx skills add`, and ~/.agents/.skill-lock.json still lists them: a later `npx skills update` or `remove` would overwrite or delete the managed copies.
